properties.abstract: On this tour you can enjoy legendary insights into the picturesque Weisstannental with the «Tectonic Arena Sardona» UNESCO site, sleepy Alps and wild nature. Most of the route covers unsurfaced roads.
properties.description:
The starting point for this bike tour is Wangs. This is also where the climb begins, leading through the Weisstannen valley to Alp Unter Precht. Upon reaching the alp, you can enjoy probably the best view of the glacier valley; the Foostock holds throne in the distance, part of the «Tectonic Arena Sardona» UNESCO site.

Through fertile forests and luscious meadows you come to the tour’s highest point, the Gamidaur Alp. The following descent is the climax of this route: Accompanied by impressive panoramas (of Churfirsten, Alvier, Sarganserland and Rheintal) the route passes through wild landscapes and woodland over unsurfaced roads and mountain roads. The route ends with the trail over the Vilterser Berg, which winds its way down into the valley in several serpentines, offering views over Sargans.
properties.title: Alp Gamidaur Bike
